prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in was helpful after adoption selection (+5.5%) or photo upload (+3.3%), but placing it after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Specific redesigns (Stage Layouts, Scroll Redesign, Choose Path Grid), new screens (Desktop Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome Screen), hints (Path Selection Hint, Sign-In Clarification), and background notification prompts (+5.1%) were helpful.
Copy updates, incentives, sound cues, notification toggles or banners, waiting screen info displays, and several other redesigns or new screens showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on tests that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.
Predictions were too low for several winning tests, predicting negative or modest impact (-8.0% to +2.4%) on changes that ultimately won (+3.3% to +14.0%).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Redesign for Upload Photos Screen: Redesign the photo upload screen using a visual card layout to streamline companion photo submission. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (64.1%) and high completion time (median 89s, mean 1017s). A visual card layout reduces friction during upload.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] New Pet Bio Preview Screen: Insert a new screen after the adoption certificate where users preview and customize their pet's bio and personality tags. (why: Adoption drops significantly at 64.1%. Providing a fun bio preview screen increases emotional attachment and commitment before pet generation.)
2: [finish, redesign] Checklist Layout Redesign for Home Intro Screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a checklist layout confirming desktop permissions, companion launch status, and controls. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet visibility issues and 3 reported confusion around desktop controls post-onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] New Companion Trait Selection Flow: Introduce a new trait selection screen right before path selection to help users define their pet companion style. (why: Choose path has an extremely high mean time (514s). A structured trait flow helps users decide faster on their companion journey.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Account Data Persistence Copy: Update sign-in copy to explicitly highlight that signing in saves your pet permanently and prevents pet reset issues. (why: 8 support emails (the largest category) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Display Generation Progress Bar on Waiting Screen: Enable progress bar and remaining time estimate on the waiting screen during pet creation. (why: The waiting stage on the home step has a high median duration (201s). Explicit progress indicators reassure users while waiting.)
6: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Companion Preview Hint: Add a reassuring hint component on the Pick Friend screen clarifying that pet traits can be adjusted anytime later. (why: Adoption drops to 64.1% as users spend significant time deciding on the companion selection step.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Toggle on Home Intro Screen: Enable background notify when ready toggle on the home intro screen so users are alerted when the pet completes desktop spawning. (why: Support mails highlight users missing the pet on desktop or leaving before pet initialization completes.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Stage Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen: Change the layout of the Choose Path screen to stage layout for a prominent view of available companion paths. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s. A stage visual layout highlights path options clearly to speed up decision-making.)
9: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Sync Mascot Hint: Add a mascot hint component on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in backs up their pet safely to the cloud. (why: 8 support requests mentioned lost or reset pets upon re-login.)
